close_reason: Fixed: take_fault doc now states double-call returns false with no effect
description: The doc comment says 'fire-once' but does not explain what happens on a second call (returns false, does nothing). A contributor who does not know HashSet::remove returns bool will not understand what 'consumed' means, and may wonder whether calling take_fault twice for the same key is an error or silently a no-op. The comment should state explicitly: 'A second call for the same (type_name, op) pair returns false and has no effect.' The 'fire-once' phrasing is a jargon shortcut that serves experienced readers but leaves new readers guessing.
title: take_fault doc does not explain what 'fire-once' means to a new reader
